verdict.rationale: Convertio's docs state it is browser-based and needs no software installed. A one-off conversion is just dropping files on the page, choosing an output format and clicking Convert, with processing done in the cloud. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the browser workflow (all evidence is first-party claims), and the free browser path has a 1 GB maximum file size.

support.subject: As a power user, a one-off conversion works in the browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: Convertio is browser-based and works for all platforms. There is no need to download and install any software.
Just drop your files on the page, choose an output format and click "Convert" button.
All conversions take place in the cloud and will not consume any capacity from your computer.
